usage: ‘姐姐’ is a noun used to refer to one's older sister in Cantonese.
You can use ‘姐姐’ when talking about your family members or when addressing your elder sister directly.
In informal speech, ‘姐姐’ can also be used respectfully to address a young woman who is older than you.
‘姐姐’ usually appears before verbs when she is the subject of the sentence, like ‘姐姐去學校’ meaning ‘older sister goes to school’.
It can be combined with other words to form phrases like ‘我姐姐’ meaning ‘my older sister’.

examples.meaning: My older sister is very smart.
